_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

nodes.name: Zoroaster (Zarathustra)
nodes.label: Zoroaster
nodes.description: Prophet and founder of Zoroastrianism who preached worship of Ahura Mazda.

nodes.name: Deioces
nodes.label: Deioces
nodes.description: First king of the Medes who united Iranian tribes and founded Ecbatana.

nodes.name: Cyaxares
nodes.label: Cyaxares
nodes.description: Median king who destroyed the Assyrian Empire and expanded Median power.

nodes.name: Cyrus the Great
nodes.label: Cyrus the Great
nodes.description: Founder of the Achaemenid Empire, conqueror of Babylon, celebrated for religious tolerance.

nodes.name: Darius I
nodes.label: Darius I
nodes.description: Achaemenid king who reorganized the empire, built Persepolis, and invaded Greece.

nodes.name: Shapur I
nodes.label: Shapur I
nodes.description: Sasanian king who defeated and captured Roman Emperor Valerian.

nodes.name: Ferdowsi
nodes.label: Ferdowsi
nodes.description: Poet who composed the Shahnameh, preserving Persian heritage in the Persian language.

nodes.name: Avicenna (Ibn Sina)
nodes.label: Avicenna
nodes.description: Polymath whose Canon of Medicine was standard medical text for centuries.

nodes.name: Rumi (Jalal ad-Din)
nodes.label: Rumi
nodes.description: Sufi mystic poet whose Masnavi ranks among greatest works of Persian literature.

nodes.name: Shah Ismail I
nodes.label: Shah Ismail I
nodes.description: Founder of Safavid dynasty who established Shia Islam as Iran's state religion.

nodes.name: Shah Abbas I
nodes.label: Shah Abbas I
nodes.description: Greatest Safavid ruler who rebuilt Isfahan, reformed the military, and expanded trade.

nodes.name: Hafez
nodes.label: Hafez
nodes.description: Beloved Persian poet of Shiraz whose ghazals are memorized throughout Iran.

nodes.name: Naser al-Din Shah
nodes.label: Naser al-Din Shah
nodes.description: Long-reigning Qajar shah who introduced modernization and was assassinated in 1896.

nodes.name: Mohammad Mossadegh
nodes.label: Mohammad Mossadegh
nodes.description: Prime Minister who nationalized Iranian oil, overthrown in 1953 coup.

nodes.name: Reza Shah Pahlavi
nodes.label: Reza Shah Pahlavi
nodes.description: Founder of Pahlavi dynasty who modernized Iran with authoritarian methods.

nodes.name: Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini
nodes.label: Ayatollah Khomeini
nodes.description: Leader of the 1979 Islamic Revolution and founder of the Islamic Republic.

nodes.name: Abbas Kiarostami
nodes.label: Abbas Kiarostami
nodes.description: Acclaimed film director whose work defined Iranian New Wave cinema internationally.

nodes.name: Shirin Ebadi
nodes.label: Shirin Ebadi
nodes.description: Human rights lawyer and Nobel Peace Prize laureate (2003) advocating for women's rights.
